title: Senior Content & Search Activation Lead
description: Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. As a part of The Brandtech Group , we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. Role: Senior Content & Search Activation Lead (6 Month-FTC) Location: London, or Northampton, England (3 days a week on-site from our Client's offices) THE OPPORTUNITY This is a six-month contract opportunity to join OLIVER'S managed services team, embedded within our client, a leading & Global Banking Institution. Sitting within their Marketing Centre of Excellence as a Senior Content & AI Search Specialist, you'll be responsible for turning search, GEO and audience insight into live content and customer experiences across priority journeys. Based in London or Northampton, with a hybrid working pattern (three days a week on-site), you'll take insight from specialist agency partners and turn it into approved, delivery-ready content and digital briefs, working with delivery teams to get activity live. Your judgement and writing will help the Unified Search programme improve how customers find and use our client's content. About the role: This is a hybrid activation role that combines content strategy, SEO, copywriting, campaign management and stakeholder management. Rather than being the primary source of search insight, you'll add value by translating specialist recommendations into clear, prioritised and deliverable activity. Your value is in taking recommendations from partners such as OMD and Profound, checking them against the Unified Search strategy, and shaping them into clear, prioritised activity. You'll secure the right approvals and work with Delivery Managers and Digital Delivery teams to move work into delivery. You'll use AI-enabled tools and workflows, such as Profound and Pencil Pro, to speed up briefing and content creation, while applying careful human judgement. You'll help build confidence in the Supercharge model by keeping recommendations moving from insight to approval, delivery and post-live learning. You'll work across a matrix of Product, Content, Design, Digital Delivery, Legal, Compliance and agency partners, with no direct reports. What you will be doing: Move search, GEO and content recommendations from agency insight or content brief through to deployment-ready activity. Review recommendations from OMD, Profound and other insight sources, and confirm they fit the Unified Search strategy, customer journey priorities and sprint objectives. Work with Product stakeholders, including product owners, to secure alignment and sign-off before activity moves into delivery. Use Profound, Pencil Pro and other AI-enabled workflows to shape content, write briefs, develop copy and optimise pages. Write, edit and refine copy and messaging where needed, turning recommendations into clear and usable content outputs. Work with the assigned Delivery Manager to translate recommendations into clear content, optimisation and digital delivery requirements. Check with Content, Design, Digital Delivery and agency partners that requirements are clear, prioritised and complete before handover. Prepare opportunities for the relevant sign-off board and coordinate stakeholder input where approval is needed. Maintain a visible backlog for your area or sprint wave, so recommendations are prioritised, progressed and tracked. Decide whether to progress, pause, re-scope or escalate an opportunity, based on risk, dependency and delivery readiness. Flag blockers, dependencies and governance issues early, and escalate them clearly through the Supercharge operating model. Make sure all content aligns with our client's brand, tone of voice, accessibility, legal, compliance and risk requirements. Feed live performance results and learnings back into future sprint activity. Risk and Control Objective: Ensure that all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements, Enterprise-Wide Risk Management Framework and our clients' internal Policies and Policy Standards. What you need to be great in this role: Experience across financial services or a heavily regulated industry Experience in content strategy, content design, copywriting or digital content. A good understanding of SEO principles, including search intent, page structure, metadata, internal linking, content quality and customer journey optimisation. Understanding of GEO and AI search principles, or a strong appetite and ability to learn quickly. Experience reviewing, writing or refining digital content, and turning recommendations into actionable briefs. Skill in using insight, customer need and search data to shape practical content and optimisation activity. Stakeholder management experience with Product, Content, Design, Digital, Legal, Compliance or agency teams. Experience taking work through approval, governance or delivery processes in a regulated environment. Organisational skills, including managing backlogs, priorities and actions, and keeping work moving through ambiguity and competing priorities. Clear communication, including explaining search and content recommendations to non-specialist stakeholders. Experience applying sound judgement and working within appropriate risk, legal, compliance and governance controls. Confidence using Gen AI tools to improve the quality and speed of content, briefing and optimisation activity. An ability to adopt and help embed repeatable AI-assisted content and briefing workflows. A systematic approach to breaking down complex, multi-step challenges. Sound judgement about where AI can add value and where human review, specialist expertise and governance are required. description: <p><strong>About Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p><strong><a href="http://www.crai.com/">Charles River Associates</a></strong> is a leading global consulting firm that offers economic, financial, and strategic expertise to major law firms, corporations, and governments around the world.  CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.</p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-size: 8pt;"><em>The statements included in this job description are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job.  They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.</em></span></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Site Reliability Engineer UK | Full-Time The Mission: Source.dev Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework , Security , and the Android Runtime (ART) . Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation. Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS. The Core Product: SourceFS SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes. 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed. 10x Lower Costs: Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine. True Engineering Productivity: Replaying hundreds of thousands of build steps instantly when inputs match. The Cultural Anchor: Own It We operate with a high degree of trust and a shared value of End-to-End Ownership : "We own our work end-to-end, from spark to finish. It’s about more than just tasks; it’s the dedication to see things through, staying curious to solve problems, thinking from first principles and ensuring we fix our customer’s problems in the best possible way.” The Role: Owning Production Reliability & Scale We are looking for a talented Site Reliability Engineer to join us at Source.dev . In this role, you will share ownership of our production environment as a whole—keeping SourceFS fast, observable, and rock-solid under heavy real-world workloads. You will have the autonomy to chase the most critical problems across the stack, with a strong initial focus on performance, where many of our biggest scaling challenges live today. Using your deep knowledge of the Linux stack and the available tools, you’ll root cause bugs, eliminate tail-latency spikes, and turn deep telemetry insights into lasting reliability and ultra performant builds. What You’ll Work On End-to-End Production Reliability & Root-Cause Analysis: Share ownership for production health—leading deep-dive investigations into anomalies, resource contention, OOMs, and partnering with core engineers to turn findings into lasting systemic fixes. Performance Diagnostics & Bottleneck Hunting: Profile, trace, and eliminate latency across CPU, memory, network, and disk I/O bottlenecks in production and benchmark environments. Linux Systems & Storage Tuning: Analyze and tune Linux kernel parameters, filesystems, caching layers, and cloud compute/storage configurations to improve reliability, eliminate tail latency, and maximize I/O throughput. Observability & Benchmarking Infrastructure: Design robust SLIs/SLOs, telemetry dashboards, and reproducible benchmarking suites to track overall system health and catch regressions under heavy concurrent workloads. Scaling Build Infrastructure: Optimize compute, caching, and ephemeral storage utilization across massive build workloads (Android, Yocto, and beyond) running on high-core cloud environments. Ideal Candidate Profile Holistic SRE & Linux Systems Mindset: You approach systems as a whole and bring deep, hands-on expertise troubleshooting, observing, and tuning Linux infrastructure at scale. You confidently use OS tracing tools like perf, eBPF and flamegraphs to isolate root causes across CPU, memory, and I/O layers, paired with strong systems programming skills (C, Rust). Scale-Obsessed: You have experience with (or a burning desire to fix) large-scale CI/CD systems, build infrastructure, or I/O-heavy distributed workloads. Impact-Driven: You embody the "Own It" mentality—you see a friction point in production or the developer journey and don’t stop until it’s resolved. Curious & Collaborative: You enjoy translating real-world customer problems into robust, production-grade solutions. Low Ego, High Impact: Beyond being a brilliant engineer, you are a thoughtful and empathetic teammate—someone who leads with kindness. Feedback Culture Champion: You embrace feedback and provide it thoughtfully; you see open, honest communication as the foundation of great teamwork. A Note on Our Search We are looking for the best talent, wherever it may be. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a perfect fit, please do apply - we value diverse backgrounds and unique problem-solving approaches. Why Join Source.dev ? AI-Native Infrastructure: We merge deep systems expertise with AI to solve the "impossible" - using AI to automate complex merges and conflict resolution for the next generation of devices. Architect the Future: Have a direct, visible impact on the infrastructure used to build the world’s most advanced hardware. Early-Stage Ownership : You’ll have a seat at the table to shape our technical roadmap, product direction, and culture from day one. Tier-One Partnerships: Work side-by-side with world-class customers, from global automotive giants to leading cloud providers. title: Software Engineer (Elite Motorsport)
description: <h3><strong>Software Engineer (Motorsport)</strong></h3> <h3><strong>DO YOU WANT TO WORK FOR THE WORLD LEADER IN ELITE SPORTS PERFORMANCE ANALYTICS?</strong></h3> <p>Catapult is a world leader in sports performance technology, serving over 5,000 teams across 40 sports. We improve many of your favorite athletes' performances with our wearable tracking technology, video and data analysis systems, and athlete management products. Our technology offers objective solutions to sport-based challenges and can be found throughout the NFL, NHL, NBA, AFL, NRL, Premier League, Bundesliga, La Liga and many more.</p> <p>In Motorsport, Catapult’s SBG race management and team strategy systems are the technology of choice for elite-level organisers and competitors around the world, including in Formula 1, Formula E, IndyCar, NASCAR, WEC/Le Mans and other worldwide endurance racing. Customers include the FIA, nine Formula 1 teams - including the 8-time World Champion Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team - the majority of Formula E teams, the winners of multiple Le Mans 24-hour races over the last 10 years - Audi, Porsche, and Toyota - and teams and organisers in both IndyCar and NASCAR. </p> <p>We have major offices in the UK (London and Leeds), USA (Boston) and Australia (Melbourne) as well as multiple smaller offices around the world.</p> <h3><strong>WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SPORTS AND WANT TO WIN</strong></h3> <p>We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic <strong>Software Engineer (Motorsport)</strong> to grow our Motorsport development team as we expand our RaceWatch products into new series and tackle new challenges.<br><br>Based in the London office (3 days a week), you will be a key player in developing new capabilities in RaceWatch, focussing on one or two racing series, and also contributing to the entire RaceWatch suite.<br><br>We believe that our customers deserve the best platform, and we are on a mission to maximise and enhance their performance through delivering the highest quality experience. As a Software Engineer, you will help us drive our products and processes forward. You will be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.</p> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO </strong><strong><br></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the development of our RaceWatch software for one or more motorsport series.</li> <li>Work with product managers and customers to design features and prioritise tasks.</li> <li>Identify ways to add innovative new features to the software.</li> <li>Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code.</li> <li>Contribute to code quality, organization, and best practices throughout the development process.</li> <li>Maintain and enhance software reliability.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL NEED</strong><strong><br></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Degree in computer science, or another scientific or technical subject.</li> <li>A passion for sport.</li> <li>2+ years working in a fast-paced, technical environment, delivering software to customers.</li> <li>A proven track record of building applications in C/C++, or another object-oriented language.</li> <li>Experience developing products, scaling them, and supporting them throughout the entire lifecycle.</li> <li>An aptitude for working with complex data.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical staff, both internally and when speaking to customers.</li> <li>A willingness to go above and beyond for the customer.</li> <li>Ability to help cover live motorsport events at weekends on a rotational basis with the rest of the team.</li> <li>An ability to multi-task and thrive in a dynamic work environment with changing priorities.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>NICE TO HAVE</strong><strong><br></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience developing Windows applications in Visual Studio.</li> <li>Experience developing applications that process video.</li> <li>Experience with ticketing and project management platforms, such as JIRA or Monday.</li> <li>Prior experience working in motorsport is an advantage.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHY CATAPULT? </strong></h3> <ul> <li>We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.</li> <li>We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication; to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.</li> <li>Our workforce spans more than 20 countries so you’ll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures.</li> <li>We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better. There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.</li> <li>We care about you. We offer outstanding paid maternity and paternity leave.</li> </ul> <p>Whether you are interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams, organisations and competitors on the planet! While we have access to many exciting opportunities, we also realize that we are here to do a very important job for our customers. As a result, we aim to work with purpose and intention. We look for people that fit into our team culture, those who actively contribute and individuals who are excited about what they do. </p> <p>In order to build the future of sports performance, we need the brightest talent. If you think you can contribute to the empowering, enjoyable and exciting Catapult environment, then we invite you to apply.</p> <p>All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.</p> <p><br><br></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER</strong></p> <p>Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to <strong>Unleash the Potential</strong> of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.</p> <p>We work with over 5,800 teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  </p> <p>Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. </p> <h4><strong>WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS</strong></h4> <p>We are looking for a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> to help build the Perch camera system, </p> <p>Based in London (hybrid), you will work across platform, perception, and ML systems. You will help us improve how we collect, process, and analyze performance data at scale, spanning from devices collecting real-time to backend services and ML infrastructure. All of which will have a direct impact on customers and their experiences with the product.</p> <p>This role suits a strong generalist who has seen many parts of engineering. You might have worked on any of the following: high-throughput systems, computer vision, robotics, ML infrastructure, or other complex applications. Our ideal candidate brings strong engineering judgment, good technical range, and the ability to learn quickly.</p> <p>You will be hands-on, working in Python and C++ on devices and services in use by our customers every day.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO </strong></p> <ul> <li><em>Design and implement algorithms for 3D object tracking, segmentation, and motion recognition on embedded hardware.</em></li> <li><em>Train and iterate on ML models — from dataset curation through training, evaluation, and deployment to edge devices.</em></li> <li><em>Help bring ML, computer vision, or signal-processing systems into production with tight performance constraints</em></li> <li><em>Build reliable application features and services that customers use in real environments.</em></li> <li><em>Analyze production data to find system limits, product issues, and opportunities for improvement.</em></li> <li><em>Collaborate closely with the embedded platform team on model optimization and inference performance, and with the applications team on how tracking data becomes product features.</em></li> </ul> <h4><strong>WHAT YOU’LL NEED</strong></h4> <ul> <li><em>4+ years of software engineering experience in production systems.</em></li> <li><em>Strong skill in Python and backend engineering.</em></li> <li><em>Working knowledge of C++ or a strong reason to be effective in performance-critical code.</em></li> <li><em>Experience with data-intensive systems, distributed systems, parallel processing, or efficient data pipelines.</em></li> <li><em>Exposure to ML, ML infrastructure, signal processing, real-time systems, computer vision, or related applied technical areas.</em></li> <li><em>A track record of shipping reliable software, not only prototypes.</em></li> <li><em>Strong debugging skills and the ability to find the root cause of complex system behavior.</em></li> <li><em>Clear communication and good judgment when tradeoffs are not simple.</em></li> <li><em>Curiosity, adaptability, and the desire to learn new technical areas.</em></li> </ul> <p><em>Nice to have — and what would make you exceptional:</em></p> <ul> <li>Experience with computer vision, depth cameras, pose estimation, tracking, or 3D data.</li> <li>Experience with ML model deployment, feature pipelines, evaluation systems, or data quality tools.</li> <li>Experience with streaming data, event systems, real-time processing, or low-latency applications.</li> <li>Experience with numerical methods, signal processing, filtering, state estimation, or robotics.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE</strong></p> <ul> <li>In 6 months time, you understand the main systems, ship reliable changes, and help improve a meaningful data or product workflow. You give valuable technical input towards solving problems across backend, data, and perception systems.</li> <li>In 12 months time, you have made a measurable impact on system reliability, product capability, or data quality. You own important parts of the architecture and help the team make better technical decisions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>WHY CATAPULT? </strong></h4> <ul> <li>We have amazing people. We promise you’ll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.</li> <li>We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. </li> <li>We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.</li> <li>Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.  </li> <li>We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.</li> </ul> <p>Whether you’re interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! </p> <p>Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.</p> <p>All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Regional Alliance Manager (EMEA)
description: Who We Are Having surpassed $300M ARR and continuing to grow, Optro helps enterprises transform risk into opportunity through its AI-powered GRC Intelligence Platform. More than 50% of the Fortune 500, including 7 of the Fortune 10, leverage our award-winning technology to move their businesses forward with greater clarity and agility. And our customers love us: Optro is top-rated on G2.com and Gartner Peer Insights. At Optro, we inspire each other to innovate and are proud of what we are producing. We spend each day thinking of new ways to help our customers and contribute to the greater good of our company and our surrounding communities. We are all about assisting each other and breaking through barriers to create the most loved audit, risk, ESG, and InfoSec platform by our customers. This is how we have become one of the 500 fastest-growing tech companies in North America for the seventh year in a row, as ranked by Deloitte! Why This Role is Exciting Optro is one of the fastest-growing software companies in the world, and we are aggressively increasing our market share throughout the EMEA Region. Our alliance partners are an integral part of that strategy. We are looking for an intelligent, coachable, and driven professional to help guide and shape our regional alliance strategy based in London. As a Regional Alliance Manager - EMEA , you’ll manage and enable Optro’s most strategic alliance partnerships and ecosystem across EMEA including the Big 4, Advisory firms, Resellers and Distribution. You will be the primary engine driving partner recruitment, activation, pipeline, training and certifications through our partner ecosystem in this key market. Key Responsibilities Regional Face of Alliances: Act as the primary point of contact for the alliance organization in EMEA, driving a clear regional strategy in cooperation with Global Alliance Directors and reporting to the Head of Alliances. Pipeline & Revenue Growth: Achieve quarterly and annual pipeline and revenue targets. Drive differentiated growth by encouraging partners to include Optro technology in their clients’ projects. Partner Lifecycle Management: Build and shape a solid partner ecosystem by recruiting, onboarding, and enabling new and existing partners. Strategic Alignment: Develop a deep understanding of partners’ business strategies and build specific Optro growth initiatives that align with their regional goals. Sales Brokerage: Act as the liaison and broker of relationships between the regional Optro sales team and the partners’ practitioners, sales organizations, and marketing teams. Territory Strategy: Increase partner-driven sales by collaborating with Regional Account Executives on activities such as Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), joint account mapping, and joint pipeline forecasting. Collaboration & Marketing: Plan and execute marketing activities, webcasts, and roadshows that generate brand awareness and influence across the EMEA region. Operational Liaison: Broker internal discussions regarding regional operational needs (such as language requirements or customer support) to ensure a positive customer experience in EMEA. Attributes for a Successful Candidate Strategic & Technical Proficiency: Ability to think strategically about business and technical challenges while conveying a compelling value proposition to consultants and integrators. Experience: At least 7 years of experience in sales or channel management, with a specific track record of success working with the Big 4, Global System Integrators, Resellers, or Managed Service Providers. Ecosystem Builder: Proven experience in building partner ecosystems and Go-To-Market strategies from the ground up or within a rapidly scaling environment. Influencing Skills: Strong networking and business development skills; able to build consensus across various functional groups and organizational boundaries. Adaptability: Effective in a matrix environment, comfortable with ambiguity, and willing to take calculated risks to achieve regional goals. Language: English (Native), French (Business Conversational) are considered a nice to have. Perks (United Kingdom) Launch a career at one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in North America and EMEA! Live your best life (LYBL)! $200/mo (USD) for anything that enhances your life Comprehensive employee health coverage Pension scheme with company contributions Competitive compensation & bonus program Generous annual leave of 25 days plus bank holidays Time off for your birthday & volunteering Employee resource groups Opportunities for team and company-wide get-togethers! *perks may vary based on eligibility/location Our Company Values Customer obsession: It starts and ends here. Consistently ask yourself how what you’re doing creates value for our customers. It’s a mindset. Gritty resilience: Make it happen. Find a way. Move fast, stay positive, and do what it takes. Drive innovation: Create the future. Continuously improve what exists and invent what’s next. Win, together: One team. No silos, no egos. Drive to be the best and support each other’s success. Growth mindset: 10x, not 10%. Think in orders of magnitude, not increments. Seek feedback, learn, and improve. We love building strong partnerships, but please note that Optro cannot accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Any submissions without a signed agreement in place will not create a fee obligation. Privacy Notice for Candidates When you apply for a role at Optro, we collect and process personal data including your contact details, resume, work history, and application responses to evaluate your candidacy. For full details on how we collect, use, and protect your data — including your rights under GDPR, UK GDPR, and US state privacy laws and other applicable data protection laws — please review our Candidate Privacy Notice . Use of AI in Recruitment: Optro may use artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to assist in the screening and evaluation of applications, including resume parsing and candidate matching. These tools do not make final hiring decisions — all assessments are reviewed by our human recruitment team. You may opt out of AI-assisted screening at any time without impact to your candidacy by contacting Interview Recording: Optro may use recording and transcription technology during interviews. You will be notified before any recording begins and may opt out at any time without affecting your candidacy. Background Checks: Background checks are required for this role. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. This role may have access to highly sensitive data, including employee data, customer data, company financials, and proprietary product information. Optro does not sell candidate personal data. title: Marketing Operations
description: About us: Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage. Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. We partner with teams across the business to hire exceptional people into a huge variety of roles, from individual contributors through to senior leadership.</p> <p>As our team continues to grow, we're looking for a Player Coach to lead a small squad of Recruiters while remaining hands-on with hiring. You'll work closely with Workforce Planning and Hiring leadership to understand upcoming demand and ensure your team is focused on the highest-impact hiring.</p> <h3><strong>You'll lead and coach a team of Recruiters</strong></h3> <p>You'll manage, coach and develop a team of Recruiters, creating an environment where people can do their best work. You'll use data, market insights and candidate feedback to identify opportunities, refine our processes and influence hiring decisions. You'll help embed inclusive hiring practices across your team and continually look for ways to improve quality, efficiency and candidate experience.</p> <h3><strong>You'll be an expert in your market</strong></h3> <p>You'll proactively source exceptional talent, understand competitor activity and share market insights with Hiring Managers and your team. You'll help shape hiring strategies that allow us to attract diverse, high-quality candidates in competitive markets.</p> <h3><strong>You'll contribute to the growth of the Tech Hiring team</strong></h3> <p>You'll work closely with other Hiring Leaders to share best practice, solve cross-functional hiring challenges and help shape how our team evolves as Monzo continues to grow</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>You've built significant experience recruiting in-house, within Product</li> <li>You've managed or coached Recruiters and enjoy helping others develop and succeed.</li> <li>You're excited by a player-coach role that combines people leadership with hands-on recruitment.</li> <li>You're insights to influence hiring decisions and improve recruitment processes.</li> <li>You're passionate about inclusive hiring and creating exceptional candidate experiences.</li> <li>You build trusted relationships quickly and thrive in fast-moving, collaborative environments.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>It would be great if...</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>You've managed hiring teams across multiple locations or hybrid/remote environments.</li> <li>You've recruited tech roles within a high-growth startup or scale-up.</li> <li>You've partnered closely with workforce planning or capacity planning teams.</li> <li>You've helped build or improve recruitment processes at scale.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></span></p> <p>💰 Competitive Salary ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Recruiter Call</strong></li> <li><strong>Loop Interviews<br></strong></li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-KG1 </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>

title: Associate, Investment Analytics
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span data-teams="true">Pantheon has been at the forefront of private markets investing for more than 40 years, earning a reputation for an innovative approach to investing in secondaries, co-investments, and primary fund investments, as well as capital formation across commingled funds, evergreen vehicles and customized solutions. Our specialist investment capabilities span multiple strategies across private equity, infrastructure and real assets, and private credit. Through our collaborative and committed culture, we find new ways to solve complex problems together and deliver innovative investment opportunities across private markets. Pantheon currently manages approximately $82.3 billion in AUM across all its strategies, serving more than 750 institutional and 638 private wealth clients worldwide</span></p> <p>For further details please visit <a href="http://www.pantheon.com">www.pantheon.com</a></p></div><p><strong>Purpose of Position</strong></p> <p>The Associate of Private Credit Investment Analytics will help build the development of Pantheon’s private credit data and intelligence capability, transforming investment data into structured, decision-ready insight for Portfolio Management teams. </p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of Investment, Data and Operations, and will focus on strengthening the firm’s ability to generate consistent, comparable, and actionable intelligence from credit portfolio data — across funds, GPs, structures, and geographies. </p> <p>The Associate will help architect and operate scalable analytical frameworks that standardize how private credit data is defined, sourced, governed, and translated into insight. The role will partner closely with Portfolio Management, Investment Data Operations and Data Engineering teams to embed credit analytics into Pantheon’s evolving data platforms, reducing reliance on bespoke spreadsheets and increasing transparency, comparability, and confidence </p> <p>This is a high-impact opportunity to shape Pantheon’s private credit data & analytics capability at a time of significant growth and platform transformation</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help build private credit investment analytics across Pantheon to help evaluate and monitor investments.</li> <li>Act as an analytics partner to Investment and Portfolio Management teams, translating complex investment needs into structured data requirements and analytical frameworks.</li> <li>Support the definition, sourcing, and validation of investment-relevant datasets, ensuring analytical outputs are complete, comparable, and decision-ready.</li> <li>Deliver differentiated actionable insights by combining internal investment operations data with GP-reported and external market data, moving beyond descriptive reporting to comparative, diagnostic, and thematic analysis.</li> <li>Represent the data and analytics interface with GPs and external data/technology providers, shaping data standards, templates, and requirements to improve transparency, coverage, and usability.</li> <li>Develop Investment Analytics to become a business-facing function with a product mindset, creating a roadmap that prioritises initiatives based on investment impact, adoption, and measurable decision enablement.<strong> </strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>Knowledge and Experience Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience in private markets, with exposure to portfolio data, analytics or investment operations </li> <li>Strong analytical mindset with demonstrated ability to support investment or portfolio decision-making, using advanced & emerging AI toolkit to elevate the speed, rigor, and quality of insight generation</li> <li>Strong understanding of data governance, comparability challenges, and portfolio transparency </li> <li>Demonstrated ability to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels </li> <li>Proven ability to partner effectively with investment professionals and influence senior stakeholders </li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to articulate complex information clearly and concisely </li> <li>Track record of delivering high-quality outputs under tight timelines </li> <li>Curiosity and openness toward emerging technologies that enhance investment intelligence and operational effectiveness</li> <li>Experience with working 3<sup>rd</sup> party providers, data vendors & offshore teams </li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Experience </strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with modern data environments and analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL, Python, Databricks, DevOps, Snowflake). </li> <li>Experience systemising investment analytics within centralized data platforms. </li> <li>Exposure to automation or advanced analytical techniques to enhance portfolio monitoring </li> <li>Deep understanding of private credit structures, performance drivers, and portfolio monitoring</li> <li>Professional qualification (CFA, ACA, ACCA, IMC) or equivalent experience preferred but not essential </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>This job description is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. You may be required to perform other job-related duties as reasonably requested by your manager.</strong></p> <p><strong>Pantheon is an Equal Opportunities employer, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't perfectly align we'd still encourage you to apply.</strong></p> <p> </p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Marketing Automation Engineer
description: <h1>Growth at United Media</h1> <p>Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.</p> <p>The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.</p> <p>You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.</p> <p>If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.</p> <h2><strong>Why United Media</strong></h2> <p>United Media (<a href="https://www.united-media.com/">https://www.united-media.com/</a>) focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.</p> <h2><strong>What we offer you</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Master the highest bar in the world.</strong> Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.</li> <li><strong>Unlimited growth potential. </strong>You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.</li> <li><strong>Skills that compound for life.</strong> Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.</li> <li><strong>Ownership from the very start.</strong> You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.</li> <li><strong>Travel opportunity.</strong> You will be joining our 10+ conferences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <p>Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build the audience.</strong> Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.</li> <li><strong>Own marketing channels that drive revenue. </strong>Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue</li> <li><strong>Write copy that persuades.</strong> Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.</li> <li><strong>Sprint, test, implement.</strong> Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.</li> <li><strong>Build systems, not one-offs.</strong> Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.</li> <li><strong>Do whatever it takes to win.</strong> Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we expect from you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>1 to 3 years of experience</li> <li>Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results</li> <li>A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.</li> <li>Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency</li> <li>Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do</li> <li>Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do</li> <li>A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people</li> <li>Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Practical details</strong></h2> <p>Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Sales Engineer - UK
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers. Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers. This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success. This role can be office-based (London) or fully remote in the UK. This role requires travel up to 50% of the time. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team. In this role, you will: Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations. Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry. Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc. Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use. Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers. Act as a liaison between Samsara's product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs. You have excellent written & verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate with confidence, clarity, and focus. This is a brand new role and our first dedicated Partner Marketing hire, so we're looking for someone who has already planned and delivered successful B2B co-marketing campaigns with external partners and is excited by the opportunity to build a partner marketing programme from the ground up! Partnerships are already an important part of how we reach and win enterprise customers. Now we want to build a proper marketing engine around them – identifying where the biggest opportunities are, creating brilliant joint propositions and campaigns, and turning our partner network into a measurable source of pipeline and growth. Reporting to our Senior Enterprise Marketing Manager, you’ll work closely with Partnerships and Sales to decide where we invest, build compelling co-marketing plans and then get stuck into delivering them. What you'll be busy doing: Building and owning our partner marketing strategy, including how we tier and prioritise partners Developing joint value propositions and co-marketing plans that resonate with our shared customers Planning and delivering campaigns across content, email, social, events and webinars Supporting partnership and integration launches with the plans, campaigns and assets needed to make them successful Owning partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline targets, tracking performance and using the results to decide where we invest Creating co-branded content and partner enablement materials, including launch packs and customer case studies Building strong relationships with our partners’ marketing teams and becoming their go-to marketing contact at Goodlord Working closely with Sales, Partnerships and the wider Marketing team to turn great partner activity into commercial results The role combines strategy with hands-on delivery, so you'll need to be just as happy working out what we should do and why as you are getting on and doing it! ABOUT YOU We're looking for someone with hands-on B2B partner, channel or alliance marketing experience, ideally in SaaS or tech, who has owned joint campaigns that generate leads and pipeline. You’ll be commercially minded and comfortable talking about pipeline and revenue, not just campaigns and engagement. You’ll understand that great partner marketing isn't about doing the same thing with every partner – it's about identifying where the opportunity is, creating something valuable for both sides and measuring whether it's working. This role is likely for you if: You’ve owned B2B partner or channel marketing campaigns end-to-end You’re comfortable connecting marketing activity to pipeline and commercial outcomes You understand how to assess and prioritise different partners and where to focus time and budget You’ve worked closely with Sales and Partnerships teams You’re comfortable balancing strategy with hands-on delivery You’re confident building relationships with external partners and internal stakeholders You’re proactive, curious and comfortable creating structure where there isn't already a playbook Experience in proptech would be a bonus, as would experience building or scaling a partner marketing programme from the ground up. This role is likely not for you if your experience is primarily generalist marketing, or if you've supported partner campaigns but haven't yet owned partner or channel marketing activity yourself. We need someone who brings genuine partner marketing experience and can connect that activity to commercial outcomes. Why you'll love being a Goodlordian Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info). Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified . Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally! Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement. Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics What’s next? If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)! A full job spec is available on request. Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Because we're an open book and we learn from each other, we actively champion diverse perspectives and unique life experiences. title: Senior Sales Development Representative - 4 Day Week + Remote
description: Still get a buzz from a cold call? Good. So do we. Our SDRs call commercial, project and operations leaders at some of the UK's biggest construction firms. They're busy, they're blunt, and they've heard every software pitch going (some of them twice before lunch). Earn their two minutes, find a genuine problem on a live project, and you'll hand over a meeting your Account Executive can actually win. You've done this before, so you know a full calendar isn't the same as a good one. Here, quality wins every time, and you'll have a playbook that works, coaching from people who know construction, and a team that backs you to do it properly. If you want your experience to count for more than your dial count, keep reading. (this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying) _________________________________________________________________________________________ We are Shape.Construction! We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest – 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. ( Watch our short film about it). We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. We are building a full suite of products one module at a time – kind of like office 365 but for construction management - Check out Shape, our construction management tech The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 220 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn't just some "job", it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. 4 core values for a good life We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. So our values reflect the 4 levels of relationships that each of us has: Grow yourself – Your relationship with yourself Care about people – Your relationship with others around you Execute to greatness – Your relationship with your team Build civilisation – Your relationship with humanity and the world This goes much deeper but for the sake of brevity, we will keep the summary version! We enshrined our values in our vision We exist so that everyone in our team can thrive in a high-impact community that: Connects us with meaningful relationships Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures We believe that, by first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world. And enable the achievement of our vision through our dual missions: To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society _________________________________________________________________________________________ The Role Purpose of the role You're where every Shape deal starts, and one of the people who sets the standard for how we prospect. As you grow, you'll shape our messaging and set the bar for the SDRs who join after you. What the job actually is You know the job. Most of your day is on the phone, and you'll hear "no", "not now" and "just send me an email" more than anything else. Here, you'll be calling commercial, project and operations leaders at tier 1 and tier 2 construction firms (main contractors and the subcontractors who work for them). They're running live projects, their time is precious and they're wary of anyone selling software. Almost all of our pipeline is outbound, apart from customer referrals, so the meetings you book are ones you've created yourself. You also know that to be good at cold calling, you have to genuinely love it. If you don't, and you plan to go through the motions, it's a boring job, and it shows on every call. We're looking for someone who still gets a buzz from turning a cold "who's this?" into a real conversation. Quality over quantity, always. We care about the work we do and take pride in doing it properly, and we want people who feel the same. You'll know a booked meeting isn't the same as a good one. Here, it means understanding their problem properly: being curious enough to ask the second and third question, listening more than you talk, and knowing by the end of the call what's actually going wrong for them, on which project, and why it matters now. It also means only offering a solution to people who genuinely want or need to fix it. If they don't, you thank them and move on. Get that right and the meeting follows naturally, and it's one worth having. How the team is set up You'll sit in the UK sales team, working day to day with an Account Executive who takes your meetings forward to a free launch and then a contract. You open the door, they win the deal, and you succeed together. You'll work with a CRM, a dialler and call recording, plus a playbook, a library of calls that have actually won, and AI call-prep tools built for how we sell. Where you'll work Remote, anywhere in the UK, with the chance to attend industry events in person in the near future. Why it's worth it A career in a market that's only just going digital: around $10 trillion is spent on construction every year, yet it's one of the least digitised industries in the world, and spending on construction management software is forecast to nearly double by 2030. People who can sell software and genuinely understand construction are rare. Learn both here, and you'll have skills that stay in demand for years as the industry catches up, and you'll be helping it work better along the way. Senior conversations from the start: you'll be speaking directly to leaders at some of the UK's biggest construction firms, not working your way through gatekeepers. Coaching that knows the industry: weekly reviews and coaching from people who've lived and breathed construction, on site, not just on the phones. A playbook that works: built from calls that have won, so you're not starting from scratch. Progression on merit: a proper conversation about your next step within a year, based on what you've shown. You'll shape how we sell: what you learn and suggest makes it into the playbook. A 4-day week: the same standards and targets, delivered in four days. Your top responsibilities Open doors: start proper conversations, every day, with the people who feel the problem and can decide. Qualify properly: test the problem early, dig in before you pitch, and keep qualifying after the "yes". Hand over cleanly: your CRM notes tell the story, so your Account Executive picks up exactly where you left off. Be obsessed with your numbers: know them every day, track them weekly and act on what they tell you. Raise the bar: once you're up to speed, share what's working, contribute to the playbook and help newer SDRs get better faster. Your roadmap: your first 30 days and beyond You bring the experience. We'll make sure you're selling the Shape way, with confidence, by week 3 or 4. Before day 1, ready to go: your CRM, dialler, call recording and your own Shape login set up, so week 1 is spent learning. Week 1, understand the why: the problems we solve, who for, and why it beats how contractors work today, with the product shown in action by Customer Success. Week 2, build your pitch: write your first-call pitch, compare it with the winning calls in our library, get it reviewed, and make your first live calls if you're ready. Weeks 3–4, up and running: calling daily with call reviews, booking your first meetings and handing them over properly. By day 30: signed off as ready to call, every call in the library listened to, and your first measures reviewed with your manager. Months 2–3, ramp: half the full target, with your own quality scorecard. By the end of month 3, full target: the same target every SDR carries, in line with your probation period. 6–12 months, step up: own a set of key accounts or a segment, help refine our messaging and set the bar for newer SDRs, with a clear path to Account Executive or SDR Team Lead. Why three months is realistic: it's quick by industry standards, and that's deliberate. You won't be figuring it out alone. You'll have a playbook built from calls that have won, regular call reviews, weekly 1:1s and your own scorecard. Our best have been fully up to speed in a month. Training never stops at day 30, however experienced you are. How you'll be measured Good numbers come from good conversations. You'll have your own monthly scorecard, built around three questions: are you reaching the right people, are those calls turning into real conversations, and are those conversations turning into meetings worth having? Your main target is qualified meetings attended : meetings that actually take place, where your Account Executive agrees there's a genuine opportunity. You'll know your numbers from day one, and we'll go through them with you every week. No grey areas: you and your Account Executive are partners. What makes a meeting qualified is written down and shared, so you'll both know where the bar is. If you ever see one differently, you talk it through with the call recording in front of you. Decisions come down to facts, never opinion or politics. What our best are doing: booking around 20% more meetings than target, turning conversations into meetings at nearly double the minimum rate, and keeping more people on the phone than our standard asks for, with almost every meeting qualified (92%) because they do the basics properly. That's the bar, and we'll help you get there. A start-up at a pivotal point If you've ever wanted to join a start-up right as it takes off, this is that moment. We're past the early days: our sales process is working, customers are launching with us and we know what good looks like. Now we're growing, and the people who join now will shape what comes next. You get the start-up stuff, the exciting and the real: things move fast, you'll build as you go, your ideas get heard (and actually used), and you'll see the impact of your work every week. We hold ourselves to a high standard, back each other up and enjoy it along the way. We're looking for people in it for the long term, and that works both ways. We'll invest in you with weekly coaching, structured training and progression on merit. In return, we want people who want to build something with us over years, not a stepping stone. Your Capabilities Must haves: Proven outbound experience at a senior level: 2+ years of phone-led B2B prospecting into directors and heads of department, in a complex sale where several people are involved in each decision and sales cycles are longer. A track record: you've been at or above target for most of the last 12 months, and you can show it. Your own toughest critic: you can listen back to your own call and say what worked, what didn't and what you'd change. A forever learner: however good you get, you never feel you know enough. title: Product Owner
description: Pet Drugs Online Role IVC Evidensia is the UK and Europe’s leading veterinary care group, made up of over 900 practices and referral hospitals, united by a shared purpose of happier animals, happier owners. At IVC Evidensia, we believe careers should be built without limits. Our people are supported to make more impact, access more career opportunities, and play an active role in their local and professional communities. Through investment in learning, innovation, and wellbeing, we create environments where our teams can grow in confidence, capability, and fulfilment—at every stage of their career. Pet Drugs Online is one of the UK’s leading online pet pharmacies and retailers, helping pet owners access trusted medication, healthcare products, and everyday essentials quickly, safely, and conveniently. As part of the IVC Evidensia Group, Pet Drugs Online combines the agility of a growing ecommerce business with the strength and expertise of a leading veterinary care organisation. Our teams play a vital role in making pet healthcare more accessible through innovation, operational excellence, and outstanding customer experience. Help shape the future of eCommerce at Pet Drugs Online. This is an exciting opportunity to join our eCommerce team at a time when there's plenty of opportunity to make a real impact. From improving website functionality and customer journeys to introducing new technologies and enhancing internal processes, there's no shortage of interesting projects to get involved in. Working closely with our Lead Product Owner, you'll play a key role in turning business ideas and opportunities into tangible improvements, bridging the gap between commercial stakeholders and technical delivery teams. The Role This is a varied, hands-on position combining Product Ownership and Business Analysis responsibilities. You'll take ownership of initiatives from initial discovery and requirements gathering through to development, testing and launch. You'll work closely with stakeholders across eCommerce, Marketing, Commercial, Customer Service and Operations, as well as our external development agency and internal technology teams. Some of the key areas you'll be involved in include: Product Development: Help shape and deliver improvements across the Pet Drugs Online website, identifying opportunities to enhance functionality and customer experience. Discovery & Requirements: Work with stakeholders to understand business challenges, explore opportunities and translate ideas into clear, actionable requirements. Backlog Management: Create and maintain product backlogs, write user stories and acceptance criteria, and support prioritisation of development activities. Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships across the business, facilitating discussions, challenging existing processes and ensuring everyone understands the objectives and proposed solutions. Agile Delivery: Work closely with developers, QA and our external development agency, supporting sprint activities, clarifying requirements and resolving queries throughout development. Testing & Launch: Support user acceptance testing, validate delivered functionality and ensure new features and improvements are ready for release. Continuous Improvement: Monitor performance, gather feedback and identify further opportunities to improve both customer-facing experiences and internal business processes. What makes this opportunity interesting? Pet Drugs Online is already a successful eCommerce business, but there is significant opportunity to take its digital offering to the next level. You'll be joining at a particularly interesting time, with several important initiatives and improvements across the website and wider customer journey. Some of the areas you'll have exposure to include: Enhancing the online prescription journey, making it easier and more straightforward for customers to purchase medication for their pets. Improving website search, product discovery and merchandising through new technologies. Developing and improving subscription journeys. Enhancing key website experiences, including the basket, checkout and customer account areas. Exploring new ways to improve customer experience, website functionality and operational efficiency. You'll have the opportunity to work across a broad range of initiatives, from smaller improvements and fixes through to larger, more strategic projects. About You We're looking for someone who understands digital products and eCommerce, enjoys solving problems and can confidently bring different stakeholders together to deliver meaningful improvements. You'll ideally bring: Experience in a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Digital Product or eCommerce role. Experience working on digital or eCommerce platforms, with an understanding of website functionality and customer journeys. A track record of contributing to digital improvements or projects, ideally with examples such as website enhancements, checkout improvements, conversion rate optimisation or platform changes. Experience gathering requirements, documenting processes and translating business needs into user stories and acceptance criteria. An understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and experience working alongside development teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data and insight to inform decisions. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences. Just as important is your approach. You'll be a self-starter who is comfortable taking ownership, working independently and making recommendations. You'll be confident challenging existing ways of working, facilitating discussions and explaining the reasoning behind your decisions.
